correctness.rationale: Explicit mass likelihoods prove retention independence including zero-support cases. A coupling yields the all-position hypergeometric maximum formula from the elementary fact that the shift TV of a unimodal discrete mass equals its mode height. Vandermonde gives the half-retention central identity; the lattice local limit theorem and concentrated Taylor expansion give sharp constants. Exact rational deletion-mask enumeration verified 108 cases; finite checks are not used as infinite proof.

value.rationale: The first exact all-position sensitivity profile for shifted single markers, with a weighted hypergeometric modal formula, gives efficient finite testing risk and a practical rate-free optimal decision test for any number of traces. It is a natural complete local hypothesis-testing problem, not a standalone unmotivated numeric example; order and constants relate to trace-reconstruction indistinguishability.
